text:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up we mapped three dependency failure modes during the outage: cloud auth token throttling, model-registry read-timeouts, and a degenerate storage retry loop. We need clear owners, short timelines, and a recurrence detection plan. Who picks which?

sam: I can take vendor verification and contractual ask (SLA extracts + escalation list). Will open the vendor ticket and request remediation commitments. Planning INF-4101, ETA Fri noon. :spiral_calendar:

lee: I'll own the model-registry fallback engineering: implement read-only degraded mode, warm local cache, and an integration test that simulates auth latency. Will have a draft runbook and PR by next Tue. INF-4102.

olivia: I'll lead auth hardening: token rotation cadence, short-lived tokens, client-side caching with safe TTL, and a health-check for token service (fast fail + circuit-breaker). Need Security sign-off on key rotation schedule. Target 2 weeks for staged rollout. INF-4103.

pete: Observability/alerts here. I'll add a combined dashboard correlating auth p95/p99 with model fetch error spikes and create an alert: (model_fetch_errors > 2% && auth_p95 > 200ms) sustained 5m -> page. Will produce a 90-day rolling digest for trend detection. INF-4104.

devops-bot: Epic created: https://tracker.local/INF-4100 "Dependency hardening: auth + registry". Tasks created: INF-4101..INF-4106.

maya: Nice. Two additional asks: (1) a simulation harness to validate stale-TTL safety, and (2) a monthly recurrence review so we catch patterns before they escalate.

lee: For the TTL sim I'll spin up a staging harness that replays historical request traces and measures model quality drift vs TTL. Will include config knobs for TTL windows. Plan to land sim infra in staging by next Tue along with the runbook.

olivia: I'll work with Product to define acceptable staleness bounds and a degradation matrix (read-only, cache-first, reject). @zara can you take the product review?

zara: Yep, I'll review the degradation matrix and provide sign-off criteria by next Wed.

sam: Also, recommend Legal review the vendor uptime & support clauses once we get the vendor remediation timeline. I'll loop in legal after INF-4101 reply.

pete: On recurrence detection: I'll own the monthly workbook and set up an automated digest to #incidents with linked graphs and correlated traces. If we see the auth->registry pattern 3x in 60d, escalate to SRE leadership and open a severity review. INF-4105.

maya: Can someone add explicit rollback steps for enabling degraded read-only mode? We need an abort path if model quality drops unexpectedly.

lee: Will add rollback and quick-rollback script to the runbook (feature-flag off + purge cache + toggle routing). INF-4106.

maya: Summary of owners & timelines:
- sam: vendor SLA & contacts (INF-4101) 12h (Fri noon)
- lee: registry fallback + staging sim + rollback steps (INF-4102, INF-4106) next Tue
- olivia: auth hardening + key rotation + degradation plan (INF-4103) 2w
- pete: dashboards, alert rule, monthly digest (INF-4104, INF-4105) 1w
- zara: product sign-off on staleness matrix next Wed

maya: I'll consolidate these into the epic and set a biweekly check-in cadence until all INF-41xx tasks are closed. Please add blockers to the epic and ping if you need more runway.

sam: One more note we should ask vendor for a formal incident remediation plan with milestones so Legal has something concrete to review. I'll request that in INF-4101.

maya: Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll move tracking to the epic and close this thread. Will keep weekly ops updated. :white_check_mark:
